expectations.text: States that Lovable produces web apps, not native store-submittable mobile apps
expectations.evidence: 'Lovable is a great fit for the prototype and validation stage: it produces a clickable web app fast' - and long-term table lists it only for prototype stage

expectations.text: Gives concrete builder-selection criteria including pricing model and code ownership/export
expectations.evidence: Section 6 'three checks': pricing model (own-agent over per-credit), code ownership ('take your code and leave, free'), feel

expectations.text: Advises validating the idea (prototype + real users) before investing in the real build
expectations.evidence: Section 2: 'Two days on the prototype, then a full week with real users' before committing to a builder
